seo.description: Stainless Steel Weight Calculator — Calculate stainless steel 304/316 weight for sheets, plates, and structural shapes with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Weight = L × W × T × ρ. SS304 = 7930 kg/m³, SS316 = 8000 kg/m³ (slightly heavier due to molybdenum).

content.introduction: Calculate the weight of stainless steel sheets and plates. SS304 density is 7930 kg/m³; SS316 is 8000 kg/m³ due to molybdenum alloying. Stainless is about 1% heavier than carbon steel.

example.description: A 1000mm × 500mm × 3mm 304 stainless steel sheet weighs 11.9 kg.

faq.q: What is the density difference between 304 and 316?
faq.a: SS304: 7930 kg/m³. SS316: 8000 kg/m³. The difference (~0.9%) is due to molybdenum in 316.

faq.q: Is stainless heavier than carbon steel?
faq.a: Yes, slightly. Carbon steel = 7850 kg/m³ vs 7930 for 304 (about 1% heavier).
